title: Ghost Town Escape 3 – Mirrored Dimension
description: As your weary eyes flutter open, they behold a desolate realm of abandonment. A spectral gust sweeps through your ethereal frame, causing a shiver to ripple down your spine. In this forlorn necropolis, you stand solitary, bereft of mortal companionship. Your duty now unfolds before you, a quest veiled in phantasmagoric riddles. Seek out and unearth 35 mystical relics, a task that shall stir the dormant portal of escape from this spectral realm!
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play the point-and-click game
